title: lightweight-provenance-and-release-microbulletin
author: Sanjay Patel
description: Context: onboarding workflows currently emit verbose release notes that are noisy for small incremental model metadata updates. This PR introduces a light-weight provenance fingerprint and a concise 'micro-bulletin' generator that produces one-line changelog bullets for model releases (intended for automated changelogs and Slack/console snippets). Motivation: reduce developer noise, make quick rollouts auditable, and provide a deterministic lightweight summary for telemetry and alerting. What this PR does: - Adds a deterministic provenance fingerprint algorithm (stable hashing over canonicalized metadata + sample stat summary) that fits in 16 bytes and is friendly to on-chain or audit logs. - Introduces a micro-bulletin generator that synthesizes a 1-2 sentence release blurb from model profile deltas, performance regression highlights, and safety tags. - Wire up a new CLI subcommand `redwood onboard microbulletin` that emits the bulletin and optional JSON payload. - Adds a commit hook for release pipelines so CI can attach micro-bulletins to nightly snapshots and to Linear/GitHub release drafts. - Includes unit and integration tests and example snippets in docs. Acceptance criteria (testable): - Fingerprint is stable across metadata reordering (tests cover canonicalization). - Micro-bulletins are <= 280 chars by default and include delta tokens when >1 field changed. - CICD attaches micro-bulletin to release draft when invoked. - Perf budget check: if average latency regression >5% a warning tag is included and CI marks checklist item. Implementation notes: - Fingerprint uses BLAKE2b-128 on canonical JSON (fields ordering deterministic, arrays trimmed to representative samples). - Micro-bulletin templates are configurable; defaults chosen to avoid leaking dataset names. - The generator avoids free-text summarization models; it's deterministic templating with ordinal heuristics for prominent fields (latency, accuracy proxies, token-cost). Rollout plan: feature-flag gated for 2 weeks in beta; initial consumers: onboarding CLI users and the on-board webhook that populates release drafts. Checklist: - [x] Fingerprint algorithm and unit tests - [x] Micro-bulletin generator and template scaffolding - [x] CLI subcommand and docs - [x] CI hook and sample release draft integration - [x] Perf tests and a small canary run Notes and caveats: This intentionally does not replace full changelogs; it is a concise supplement for high-volume onboarding. Related work: ENG-1982 for release automation, PM-321 for UX requirements.

review_comments: Alyssa Chen (review): Please ensure the fingerprint is stable when metadata contains extra whitespace or different key ordering. Also request an explicit non-regression test for identical profiles with reordered fields.
Author reply (Sanjay): Added canonicalizer and tests for whitespace/ordering; used canonical JSON with explicit sorting and trimming rules. See test_microbulletin.py::test_fingerprint_stability.
Morgan Reyes (review): The bulletin is helpful but can leak sensitive dataset names in the short form. Suggest default redaction and a config flag to opt-in to full details.
Author reply (Sanjay): Default now redacts dataset identifiers; added --expose-details CLI flag gated by feature-flag and admin role. Documented in microbulletin.md.
Ibrahim Khalid (review): We should include perf-budget gating; if latency regression >5% fail the checklist or at least tag the bulletin.
Author reply (Sanjay): Added perf check step and a 'perf-warning' tag. CI will set status in the release draft and the micro-bulletin will include the warning if threshold exceeded.
Alyssa Chen (approval): Approving after requested tests added and redaction behavior clarified.
ci_checks: e2e: rerun needed (one flaky test, rerun succeeded)
release_notes:
- Add deterministic 16-byte provenance fingerprint for model onboarding; stable across metadata reordering and whitespace.
- Introduce 'micro-bulletin' one-line release summaries for automated changelogs and snapshots.
- New CLI: 'redwood onboard microbulletin' and CI hook to attach bulletins to release drafts.
Notes: default redaction of dataset identifiers; opt-in flag available for admins.
notes: Deployed behind feature-flag 'onboard_microbulletin' and enabled for internal beta. Follow-up: hook into Slack release channel and add telemetry metric for bulletin consumption rates.
smoke_test_summary: Canary run (10 model onboards) emitted micro-bulletins for each release; two bulletins included perf-warning tag for a small P50 regression and were flagged in nightly overlay. No downstream failures observed.
